task.pr_title: GLSLNodeBuilder: Check texture type when declaring usampler3D/sampler3D uniforms

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: There is one side effect of this change which isn't ideal: If a `compareFunction` would be set for 3D texture, it would create a `sampler2DShadow()` command. That should not be the case.

evidence.thread_resolution: zonkypop: I did a small change which makes it check whether it's a texture3D before texture.compareFunction which should hopefully fix that.
